page.layout: One page of running verse, set in italic; running head at top; catchword "Sed" at lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: Non vllius cita trabis celerrima Praeteruolabit hunc fuga.
Nam seu volandum est palmulis; seu linteo, Nec linteo, nec palmulis.
Potis est Draconis vlla nauem consequi, Nec vim Draconis fallere.
Testatur hoc sinus minoris Adriæ, Testantur hoc & Cyclades.
Euxini Neptune, & Tomitani salis Neptune, tibi isthæc nota sunt.
Nosces Draconem, Hispane, nosces Anglicos Animos, & invictas manus.
Debes Philippe damna, luctum patriæ, Ludibrium vento & mari.
En fortis urget te Draco, invictum tibi En obiicit robur virum:
Te te catenis illigabit, te Draco Damnabit atro carcere.
Pars, esca piscium voracium, breui Natabis imo gurgite.
Pars præda mergis es futura hiantibus, Eiecta curuo in litore.
Quæ tu minatus es Britannis vincula, Hæc ipse vinctus indues.
Quid ora tot rostrata ducis navium, Seruus futurus hostium?
Ut vela das retrò! ut fugam capessis! ut Pugna timidè dilaberis!

page.notes: Printed "Ani:nos" in the line "Animos, & invictas manus" shows a stray mark between "Ani" and "nos"; copied as printed with the colon. The word at the end of "Hæc ipse vinctus indues" is set with a ligature and may read differently. The text is set in italic throughout; the long s is rendered as s. No margin notes, and no reference marks in the text.
